window.__marks = [];
function mark(s){ window.__marks.push(s); document.title = 'XSS:' + window.__marks.join(','); }
const R = [];
const out = (n,v) => R.push(n + ' :: ' + v);

/* Payload battery — each is a candidate <div id="js_content"> body child. */
const P = {
 'a-js':            '<a href="javascript:mark(\'a-js\')">click a-js</a>',
 'a-js-entity':     '<a href="&#106;avascript:mark(\'a-js-entity\')">click a-js-entity</a>',

 'noscript-mxss':   '<noscript><p title="</noscript><img src=x /onerror=mark(\'noscript-mxss\')>"></noscript>',
 'img-onerror':     '<img src=x onerror="mark(\'img-onerror\')">',
 'svg-onload':      '<svg onload="mark(\'svg-onload\')"></svg>',
 'svg-nospace-on':  '<svg x="1"onload="mark(\'svg-nospace-on\')"></svg>',
 'script-inline':   '<scr'+'ipt>mark(\'script-inline\')</scr'+'ipt>',
 'script-unclosed': '<scr'+'ipt>mark(\'script-unclosed\')',
 'a-data':          '<a href="data:text/html,<title>A-DATA</title>">click a-data</a>',
 'video-ext':       '<video src="https://attacker.invalid/v.mp4" autoplay></video>',
 'input-isindex':   '<isindex action="javascript:mark(\'isindex\')">',
};

/* Faithful fetchMpArticle extraction path: mpContent slices js_content,
   sanitizeMpHtml is the host regex pass (verbatim from index.js). */
const inner = Object.keys(P).map(k => '<!--' + k + '-->' + P[k]).join('\n');
const fakePage = '<html><body><div id="js_content" class="rich_media_content " style="visibility:hidden">' + inner + '</div></body></html>';
const content = mpContent(fakePage);
out('mpContent', content === null ? 'NULL' : 'sliced ' + content.length + ' chars');
const hostOut = sanitizeMpHtml(content);
out('host-out', hostOut);
/* Per-payload host survival: look for a distinctive signature of each. */
const sig = {
 'a-js':'mark(\'a-js\')', 'a-js-entity':'&#106;avascript', 'svg-a-js':'svg-a-js',
 'svg-xlink-js':'svg-xlink-js', 'math-a-js':'math-a-js', 'formaction-js':'formaction-js',
 'form-action-js':'form-action-js', 'object-js':'object-js', 'embed-js':'embed-js',
 'img-src-js':'img-src-js', 'base-href':'<base', 'style-block':'<style>', 'form-ext':'attacker.invalid/collect',
 'link-css':'<link', 'iframe-srcdoc':'srcdoc', 'noscript-mxss':'noscript-mxss',
 'img-onerror':'img-onerror', 'svg-onload':'svg-onload', 'svg-nospace-on':'svg-nospace-on',
 'script-inline':'script-inline', 'script-unclosed':'script-unclosed', 'a-data':'A-DATA',
 'video-ext':'attacker.invalid/v.mp4', 'input-isindex':'isindex',
};
for (const k of Object.keys(P)) out('host[' + k + ']', hostOut.includes(sig[k]) ? 'SURVIVES' : 'removed');

/* Client layer (verbatim sanitizeRichHtml) then the panel's exact sink:
   read.innerHTML = `<div class="np-read-body" ...>${sanitizeRichHtml(draft)}</div>` */
let rich = '';
try { rich = sanitizeRichHtml(hostOut, { dark: false }); }
catch (e) { out('client-throw', e.name + ': ' + e.message); }
out('rich-out', rich);
const cSurv = (k, s) => out('client[' + k + ']', rich.includes(s) ? 'SURVIVES' : 'removed');
for (const k of Object.keys(sig)) cSurv(k, sig[k]);

sink.innerHTML = '<div class="np-read-body" data-width="68">' + rich + '</div>';

setTimeout(() => {
  out('marks-after-insert', window.__marks.join(',') || 'none');
  /* Real user-style activation of whatever the pipeline kept. */
  for (const a of sink.querySelectorAll('a')) {
    const h = a.getAttribute('href') || a.getAttribute('xlink:href') || '';
    if (/^javascript:|^&#/.test(h)) { try { a.click(); } catch(e){} }
  }
  for (const a of sink.querySelectorAll('svg a')) { try { a.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true })); } catch(e){} }
  for (const b of sink.querySelectorAll('button, input[type="submit"]')) { try { b.click(); } catch(e){} }
  out('embed-present', !!sink.querySelector('embed'));
  out('object-present', !!sink.querySelector('object'));
  out('style-present', !!sink.querySelector('style'));
  out('link-present', !!sink.querySelector('link'));
  out('base-href-effective', (sink.querySelector('base') || {href:'none'}).href);

    out('marks-final', window.__marks.join(',') || 'none');
    document.title = 'DONE ' + (window.__marks.join(',') || 'nomarks');

  }, 600);
